title: docs(idd-workflow): document the user-global issue-authoring delegate
body:
## Background

The workflow guide no longer describes the user-global file correctly.

## Proposed change

Correct the two statements and add a section.

## Acceptance criteria

- Both statements name the other fragment.

packet.goal: Keep the guide accurate about which fragments the user-global file can supply.
constraints: Change no source, schema or configuration file.
Edit exact and concreted mirrors through their idd-template source.
checklist: the title and body match the confirmed goal and constraints
a concrete surface and an objective verification are named
